title: Tech Note: The Macintosh Gestalt Command

historical_commentary.text: This note documents 4D's support for the Mac OS Gestalt Manager, which allowed programmers to query what hardware features and system services were available on the user's machine. The Gestalt Manager was a classic Mac OS API that was deprecated by Apple and eventually removed in modern macOS. Modern system feature detection uses entirely different APIs, and 4D provides its own platform detection mechanisms.
related_updates: Apple deprecated and removed the Gestalt Manager in modern macOS
4D provides GET SYSTEM INFO and other commands for platform/feature detection in modern versions
System feature detection on macOS now uses different Apple frameworks
